answer: Audit timing and style correlation. Each epoch the network logs when every answer arrives and fingerprints its wording. If two accounts submit within the same 2-second window in 8 of 10 epochs, or their quill habits (phrasing, punctuation, word choice) match above 0.9, they are merged into one identity and share a single reward. To dodge this, a 1,000-puppet farm must give every puppet its own schedule and voice, roughly a separate model run per account. Its edge wears away like marble on a windswept mesa.
